fields.paper_left: ModelCompare.ai: 12 models, 10 labs, three countries, totally independent takes
fields.paper_right: 29/35 answers: “wrong together”; seven models said it all three times

narrative_summary: A supposedly global chorus of independent AI opinions turns out to be one enormous group project about human conformity.
rationale: Candidate 2 has the sharpest closing beat: “wrong together” turns the story’s conformity finding into a clean group-project joke, while the seven repeated answers add factual escalation. Candidate 4 is equally structured but ends on a weaker repeated “right?” rather than a distinct punchline.
story_title: Every AI model has the same "controversial" take on humans
place: at a robot rights protest outside Congress
